summary: Tested the 'Map of the Restless' feature end to end. Backend: 35/35 pytest pass (the new test_map_api.py has 13 tests, plus the forge and intel regression suites). Frontend: most map flows work at 1440: the navbar Map link, lazy-loading of the Leaflet chunk, 9 live markers (5 hotspots, Forge, 3 sightings), hotspot and sighting popups, popup and key Investigate (scroll to Intel and run the search), the 3 layer toggles with aria-pressed, route stats and fly-to, no scroll hijack, both pin flows (pick on the map, and pin at the haunt) with the new marker showing, and the mobile engage/release buttons. The regression smoke passed: hero 3D, add-to-crate badge 0->1, inspector presets and drag, Intel search (1 live You.com call). Bugs found: (1) clicking or tapping an illustrated sigil does not show its label, so labels never appear on touch; (2) at 375px the overview grid is 382px wide and its right edge is clipped by about 27px; (3) the station sign text overflows its box; (4) the temporary pending-pin marker stays on the map after the sighting is submitted.

minor.issue: The sightings collection holds 2 non-TEST records that are not seeded data: tscheck-log-39950150 and tscheck-log-mwpgk04v (location 'Somewhere'). They predate this run (created 20:53/20:55, probably by the main agent's own checks). They show in the Field Logs ledger. I did not touch them.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking or tapping a sigil shows no label. Mouse: mouseenter/focus sets active, then onClick runs setActive(on ? null : h.id) and clears it. Touch: the emulated mouseenter/focus fire before click, so a tap also cancels itself. Verified: hover shows the label; a real click (1440) gives 0 labels; a tap on an iPhone UA at 375 gives 0 labels. The 'hover or tap labels' requirement fails on touch.

At 375px the first grid (illustrated map plus hotspot key) is 382px wide (x 20 to 402). Root overflow-x-clip hides the overflow, so document scrollWidth stays 375, but the right edge of the illustrated card, its scroller and the hotspot key rows is cut off. The map-key-investigate-* buttons are half clipped (x 357-389). Root cause: the second <Reveal delay={100} className='space-y-4 lg:col-span-4 ...'> is missing min-w-0, so the truncated hotspot names push the implicit auto grid track out to min-content. The live-map grid has min-w-0 on both columns and is fine (335px). Fix: add min-w-0 to that Reveal, or grid-cols-1 to the grid.

After a pinned sighting is submitted, MapSection's pendingPin is never cleared. App only clears logPin. The untitled pending marker stays next to the new 'Sighting by ...' marker (1 untitled .leaflet-marker-icon remains), so one log shows as two markers. Also, the new sighting marker is fanned 34px away from the tapped spot when it is within 400m of a haunt. Fix: clear pendingPin when logPin returns to null or the sighting is created, for example via a callback or effect.

issues: The 58-letter text (fontSize 8.4, about 300px wide) overflows its 190px rect on both sides and runs into the railway line. Visible at 1440 and 768. Add textLength='182' lengthAdjust='spacingAndGlyphs', or widen the rect.
A short route (Platform Shakedown, 0.27 km) flies to zoom 16+ up to maxZoom 18 while tiles are maxNativeZoom 16, so the basemap is blurry and over-scaled. Pass maxZoom: 16 to flyToBounds.
FieldLogForm is keyed by pin.id, so dropping or moving a map pin while the form is half-filled remounts it and loses what was typed (code review, not run in the UI).

action_items: Fix the IllustratedMap sigil click/tap toggle so a click or tap always shows the label (e.g. onClick={() => setActive(h.id)} and close on outside click, or ignore the click when the active state was just set by hover/focus)
Add min-w-0 to the HotspotKey/Legend Reveal column in MapSection (first grid), so content is not clipped at 375px
Clear MapSection pendingPin after the pinned sighting is created
Fit the 58-letter station sign text inside its rect
critical_code_review_comments: IllustratedMap.jsx lines 70-74: the onMouseEnter/onFocus and onClick toggle fight each other, so a click or tap cancels itself
MapSection.jsx: pendingPin state is never reset; it needs to be tied to App's logPin lifecycle
test_forge_api.py created a TEST_Logger sighting with no cleanup (no DELETE endpoint). Fixed: it now deletes its own sighting by id via Mongo
Backend: the _resolve_pin, SightingCreate lat/lng validators and RoutesResponse model are clean, and /api/routes is static seed data that matches the hotspot ids

success_rate.frontend: about 85% (all core flows pass; 1 high and 1 medium UI bug)

seed_data_creation: None. All TEST_ sightings created by pytest or the UI were deleted by id (log-0258afab, log-be4588e8 and the pytest ids). The DB holds 5 sightings again: log-001..003 plus the 2 pre-existing tscheck logs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<frontend/.env> pytest tests/ -p no:xdist. test_map_api cleans up its sightings via pymongo. In the UI, the interactive map only mounts once #map is near the viewport, so click nav-link-map and then scroll_into_view_if_needed on [data-testid=interactive-map]; loading /#map does not scroll. To test mobile touch, create a new context with is_mobile=True, has_touch=True and an iPhone UA. The engage text then reads 'Tap to explore the map' and the .leaflet-touch-drag class toggles. Recheck the sigil tap label at 375, map-key-investigate-* clipping at 375, and that no untitled .leaflet-marker-icon remains after a pinned submit.
